messages:
Mike: quick heads-up — ran a latency sweep on /v1/embeddings (staging) and hit a cliff when we mix short (64) and long (2048) dims in the same batch. reproducible with the new batching shim.
Anya: ugh. do you have the payload sample?
Mike: pasted below. note the response P95 jumps from ~120ms to ~850ms once >30% of vectors are 2048.
```
{
  "inputs": [vec64, vec64, vec2048, vec64, vec2048, ...]
}
```
Raj: interesting — could be a path in the runtime that switches kernel/tiling for long dims and disables some batching optimizations. we saw something similar for sequence-length on text gen.
Dana: console question: how are we surfacing this? current embed dashboard only shows avg latency and token-ish units, not per-dim percentile.
Mike: exactly — the telemetry is aggregated by route/model but not by "dim composition". I added a temp metric: embeddings.latency.pct_by_dim_bucket (64, 128, 512, 2048). shows spikes.
Anya: can we map that into a Console matrix? e.g., rows=dim bucket, cols=batch size, color by p95. helps oncall triage.
Raj: doable. runtime already emits dim_histogram tag. need an inexpensive rollup in ingestion to avoid cardinality blowup. propose bucketing dims and only emit p50/p95/p99 per bucket per minute.
Dana: agree. UX: add a toggle on the embeddings route page "show dim matrix" that flips on the expensive aggregation for 12h. default off. add a tooltip explaining billing/ingestion cost.
Mike: K. other ops concern: routing policy should avoid mixing very different dim sizes in one batch when latency cliff exists. can we add a soft-affinity in router: prefer same-dim coalescing and only mix if latency budget allows?
Raj: we have a cheap heuristic already (coalesce by shape). it degrades throughput for small requests though. maybe a hybrid: prefer same-shape but allow mixed when server idle > X ms.
Anya: could we do a predictive policy: estimate p95 for candidate mix (based on recent metrics) and if predicted p95 > route.slo, force separate batches?
Mike: that would be nice — need a fast estimator in router. we can expose a small ML model or even a simple sliding quantile table.
Dana: rollout plan for console and router change: propose canary 10% of traffic on dedicated embed route with matrix telemetry + router soft-affinity. watch embeddings.latency.p95_by_bucket and cpu/gpu utilization.
Raj: +1. add alert: if p95_by_bucket(2048) > route.slo * 1.2 for 5m during canary, auto-fallback to strict same-dim batching.
Mike: I'll prepare a quick patch to the router (coalesce_by_shape + idle_threshold) and a console PR for the matrix widget.
Anya: I'll draft the telemetry ingestion change (bucketed p95/p99 per minute) and the cost estimate for increased metrics. pinging deploy-bot when ready. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: deployment scheduled: router/embeddings-coalesce v12 -> staging at 2026-04-02T18:40Z.
Dana: noted. thanks everyone. next: after canary we should discuss whether to expose a per-tenant preference (prefer_latency vs prefer_throughput) in Console so customers can pick routing behavior.
Mike: good call. that would be a nice product toggle.
Anya: logging note — capture an example batch payload (scrubbed) when predicted_p95 > actual_p95*1.5 so we can debug edge cases. keep sample rate low.
Raj: agree. I'll add that and a short runbook entry.
Dana: cool. i'll file the Console ticket and the UX copy for the toggle.
Mike: thanks — will update thread with canary links and dashboard screenshots when ready.
